About the Role:
GNY, a leading law firm in Israel is seeking talented and enthusiastic engineers to join our growing Intellectual Property (IP) team as a Trainee Patent Attorney, working alongside patent attorneys and attorneys at law.

This is a unique opportunity to apply your engineering knowledge in a rewarding and stimulating legal environment.

What You’ll Do:
• Assist in various

IP projects, gaining practical experience in engineering principles

Learn about all aspects of IP practice, including:
Patent, design, and trademark prosecution
Copyright matters
Legal opinions and due diligence
IP litigation
Interact with innovative individuals and sophisticated companies shaping our future
Train under professionally skilled and academically renowned

IP practitioners
Requirements:

BSc degree (minimum), preferably in:
Mechanical Engineering
Aeronautical Engineering
Electrical Engineering
Physics
Academic Excellence:
Minimum average score of 80 from a leading university
College graduates: minimum average score of 87
Excellent command of written and spoken English and Hebrew
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to conceptualize complex matters
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Positive attitude towards teamwork
What We’re Looking For:
Passion for technology and innovation
Strong interest in intellectual property law
Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, multifaceted work environment
Keen attention to detail
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Why Join Us:
Gain unique experience at the intersection of technology and law
Work on cutting-edge innovations across various industries
Develop a diverse skill set applicable to both technical and legal fields
Opportunity for professional growth and potential career transition into IP law
Qualified candidates, please submit your resume, academic transcripts, and a cover letter explaining your interest in IP

· השתלבות בפרויקטי פיתוח בתחום הבקרה התעשייתית והאוטומציה.
· הסקת אלגוריתם נדרש לתכנות בהתאם לתהליך או מכונה.
· כתיבת/עריכת קוד בהתאם לאלגוריתם וביצוע וולידציה.
· תכנון בדיקות וניסיונות לפיתוח ותמיכה במוצרים חדשים.
· ניתוח נתונים ותוצאות ניסוי, הסקת מסקנות והמלצות על שיפורים.
· השתתפות בפיתוח מוצרים חדשים.

דרישות:
· סטודנט/ית לתואר ראשון בהנדסת מכונות או להנדסת חשמל – שנה ב’ עד שנה ג’ - חובה!
· היכרות בסיסית עם תחום הבקרה התעשייתית: מנועים, בוכנות, מנגנונים מכאניים - חובה.
· היכרות עם מבנה לוח חשמל והבנה בסיסית בתקני חשמל.
· שליטה בשפות תכנות מגוונות - כתיבת קוד, שפות תכנות שונות, וולידציה.
· עקומת למידה מהירה ויכולת ניתוח והסקת מסקנות.
· יכולת עבודה פיזית במעבדה, במפעל ובשטח.
· יכולת עבודה בצוות.
· שליטה באופיס.
· אנגלית ברמה גבוהה – קריאה, דיבור וכתיבה - יתרון.
** נדרשת הגעה עצמאית למפעל בחצרים, יומיים מלאים בשבוע לפחות.

About the Role:
GNY, a leading law firm in Israel is seeking talented and enthusiastic engineers to join our growing Intellectual Property (IP) team as a Trainee Patent Attorney, working alongside patent attorneys and attorneys at law.

This is a unique opportunity to apply your engineering knowledge in a rewarding and stimulating legal environment.

What You’ll Do:
• Assist in various

IP projects, gaining practical experience in engineering principles

Learn about all aspects of IP practice, including:
Patent, design, and trademark prosecution
Copyright matters
Legal opinions and due diligence
IP litigation
Interact with innovative individuals and sophisticated companies shaping our future
Train under professionally skilled and academically renowned

IP practitioners
Requirements:

BSc degree (minimum), preferably in:
Mechanical Engineering
Aeronautical Engineering
Electrical Engineering
Physics
Academic Excellence:
Minimum average score of 80 from a leading university
College graduates: minimum average score of 87
Excellent command of written and spoken English and Hebrew
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to conceptualize complex matters
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Positive attitude towards teamwork
What We’re Looking For:
Passion for technology and innovation
Strong interest in intellectual property law
Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, multifaceted work environment
Keen attention to detail
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Why Join Us:
Gain unique experience at the intersection of technology and law
Work on cutting-edge innovations across various industries
Develop a diverse skill set applicable to both technical and legal fields
Opportunity for professional growth and potential career transition into IP law
Qualified candidates, please submit your resume, academic transcripts, and a cover letter explaining your interest in IP

About this role

מכבי שירותי בריאות מגייסת סטודנט/ית לאֲחָיוּת במרחב גליל עליון הצעד הראשון בקריירה וצבירת ניסיון בארגון שירותי הבריאות הטוב בישראל.

סיוע לאחות מוסמכת במתן שירותי סיעוד במרפאה והתמקצעות בקהילה.

במסגרת העבודה תיקח/י חלק ברשימת פעולות המאושרות על ידי משרד הבריאות.

ניטור/מדידות/בדיקות/ חבישות/אק"ג ועוד מגוון פעולות בניהול מקצועי של אחות אחראית וצוות המרפאה/מתקן רפואי
על המשרה:

אופק התפתחותי אישי ומקצועי - אפשרות להשתלבות בתפקידים שונים.
הזדמנות להיות חלק מצוות ולעבוד באווירה משפחתית.
היקף המשרה כ- 40% (גמיש)
מיקום המשרה- מרחב גליל עליון(קרית שמונה, צפת)
דרישות התפקיד:
סטודנט/ית ללימודי תואר ראשון בשנים א-ד' או בהסבה לאֲחָיוּת שנה א' - חובה.
מכוונות ומחויבות טיפולית.
יחסי אנוש טובים, יכולת השתלבות בצוות.
על פי הוראת משרד הבריאות, נדרש לבצע בדיקה במרפאה תעסוקתית והשלמת חיסונים, בהתאם לתכנית החיסונים של עובדי מערכת הבריאות.

description:
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE-I, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

Key job responsibilities

- Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.

- Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.

- Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.

- Conduct code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.

- Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.

- Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.

- Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.

- Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.

- Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

Basic qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent, or experience in software development

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

- Experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

- Experience with data structure implementation, basic algorithm development, and/or object-oriented design principles

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields

Preferred qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

- Experience with one or more of the following: Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), Database systems (SQL and NoSQL), Contributing to open-source projects, Version control systems, Debugging and troubleshooting complex systems

- Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly

- Demonstrated ownership and initiative in seeing work through from design to operation

- Basic understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC)

- Strong problem decomposition, problem-solving, and analytical skills

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Software Development Engineer - 2027

description:
Annapurna Labs is a fabless semiconductor company founded by industry veterans. We develop leading-edge products on state-of-the-art process technologies, and we're looking for talented engineers to help us build a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.

You'll help develop state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture, working on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider in a dynamic, open and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries.

You'll join the SoC Power Analysis team on the Graviton and Nitro product line. The team owns the full process of Power Analysis from architecture stages till post Si, including Arch definition and Si configuration of Power Management features.. We work closely with product definition, pre- and post-silicon validation, physical design, software and other teams across the full chip development cycle, from idea to mass production. Your work will impact the efficiency of chips in AWS data centers worldwide, and hence will have large-scale impact.

At Annapurna Labs, you'll play a key role in developing the next generation of semiconductor platforms for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, and in shaping the future of cloud computing.

Watch these videos to learn more about Annapurna Labs and the Graviton project:

AWS re:Invent 2025 - Keynote with Peter DeSantis and Dave Brown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0

AWS re:Invent 2025 - AWS Graviton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=haSHl2BLhm8

Key job responsibilities

- Analyze SoC Power consumption at Pre and Post Si stages

- Contribute to SoC Power optimization during all stages of Design Cycle

- Work with variety of teams to impact the quality of SoC power efficiency: Logic & Physical Design, PDN, Post-Si.

- Optimize Power Team analysis processes to raise effectiveness of our work.

- Solve challenging problems on a daily basis.

A day in the life

- Work on state-of-the-art processor technology

- Engage in the complete chip development cycle, from initial architecture through post-silicon analysis

- Solve complex, multidisciplinary challenges

- Collaborate with talented teams across the organization

- Contribute directly to next-generation cloud computing solutions

Basic qualifications
- BSc in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering

- Strong problem solving skills

- Ability to handle multidisciplinary tasks that require knowledge in different chip design domains, and to work in a rapidly changing environment.

Preferred qualifications
- Previous experience (including academic projects or internships) in the following domains: Power analysis and optimization, Logic design, Backend design, Chip Verification.

- Familiarity with power analysis tools such as PrimeTime/PrimePower, PowerArtist, or Voltus

- Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: C, Python, Tcl.

- Strong communication skills and ability to effectively communicate and cooperate with other teams to complete tasks.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Junior Software Engineer in the Emerging Growth group in our Tel Aviv office, you'll play a vital role in building one of Taboola's newest and most strategic growth domains: a self-service platform that lets advertisers and partners independently build, optimize and scale their campaigns.

We're an AI-native team. AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor are part of how we design, build, test, review and operate our systems every day, and we build our own agents, skills and automated workflows on top of them. We're looking for someone early in their career who learns fast, takes on new languages and challenges without hesitation, and uses AI to multiply their impact.

Our Tech Stack:

- AI: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, MCP, Langfuse and much more

- Backend: Java, Spring, Python, Kafka, MySQL, Cassandra, Vertica, HDFS, BigQuery, Druid, Docker, K8S, Grafana

- Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, Jest, Playwright

To thrive in this role, you'll need:

- B.Sc in Computer Science or equivalent

- 1–2 years of hands-on software development experience in a production environment, as an intern, in a student position or full-time

- Hands-on AI: you use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as part of your daily development workflow, and you know how to check and verify what they produce

- Fast learner: you pick up new languages, frameworks and domains quickly, and you aren't afraid to dive into what you don't know

- The ability to juggle several workstreams and switch context well, including coordinating multiple AI agents working in parallel

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- A product-driven mindset and a passion for working close to the business

Bonus points if you have:

- Experience with Java or other object-oriented languages (C#, Kotlin, C++ or similar)

- Experience building AI agents, MCP servers, custom skills or automated workflows on top of AI coding tools

- Full-stack experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, Vertica, Cassandra)

- Exposure to large-scale distributed systems, Kafka, Docker or Kubernetes

- Experience with big data tools (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow)

- Graduated with honors

How you'll make an impact:

- Have end-to-end ownership: design, build, ship, measure and maintain frontend and backend services in a brand-new product domain

- Work AI-first: use AI coding agents every day to plan, code, test, review and debug, often running several agents in parallel on different tasks

- Build AI agents, skills and workflows that multiply the team's capabilities, such as automated code reviews, data analysis, production investigation and feature validation

- Develop at unimaginable scale, serving thousands of requests per second

- Influence directly on the way billions of people discover the internet

- Collaborate closely with the brightest engineers, product managers and business teams

- Work on innovative projects that are the next growth engines for Taboola

Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

- Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.

- Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits and well-being programs tailored to the region, a fully stocked kitchen, and location-specific perks.

- Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office, with an option to come in more often if desired.

- Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Condé Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

description:
The SIP (Signal-Integrity & Packaging) team is part of Annapurna Labs’ Chip development team. The team is dealing with the external electrical interfaces of the device, from their Signal/Power-integrity and electrical usage perspectives.

The team’s work includes close work with the BackEnd team on integrating these interfaces to the Die, the package layout design of the BGA’s substrate, Signal and power integrity simulations, and working with the system team to come up with optimal pin-out and optimal PCB breakout schemes.

We are looking for highly motivated Electrical Engineering graduates, or engineers with up to 3 years’ experience in related fields, to join our growing team specializing in Signal Integrity and IC Package Design. The position offers a unique entry point into a diverse and multidisciplinary domain.

Key job responsibilities

As a SIP engineer, you will be involved in:

● Work on advanced high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR and Ethernet.

● End-to-end solution of high-speed interfaces; from floor-planning at the DIE level, through Package and PCB routing, addressing both robust SI/PI considerations as well as optimizing layout routing.

● Signal and power integrity modeling and simulation of high-speed interconnects using advanced SI/PI simulation tools.

Basic qualifications
- BSc in Electrical Engineering or in related field

- 1-3 years of experience in board design, or lab measurement of digital high-speed interfaces or layout or physical design.

- Familiarity with Signal and Power integrity simulation tools.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with high-speed digital interfaces such as DRAM/PCIe/SerDes.

- Previous experience with lab equipment (e.g oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer)

- Experience with simulation/extraction tools (e.g. HFSS, Sigrity, HSpice)

description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizationsשׂ work and outpace their competition.

Our revenue organization just redesigned itself around AI -not as an add-on, but as the engine. The AI backbone now carries knowledge, content, communications, onboarding and gap resolution across every region, 24/7, without a human dispatcher. We built the prototype ourselves and it works. This role is who we hire to make it real infrastructure.

The Center of Revenue Excellence (CORE) is built on a simple premise: AI carries the scale, humans carry the judgment. Our Platform & Knowledge team decides what the revenue org needs to know and how it should learn it. You build the systems that deliver it -and you own whether they stay healthy.

About The Role

-
Build the AI backbone. Knowledge agents and their modes, agentic onboarding, AI simulations, AI-run certifications, content generation at scale, automated comms, and knowledge application analytics. Eight live components today, and a roadmap with room for more.

-
Own the health of the system. Not just shipping — reliability, accuracy, cost, and uptime on infrastructure the entire revenue organization depends on. This is the part of the job nobody else can do for you.

-
Scope before you commit. Analyze what's technically and economically possible, tell us honestly what a capability will cost to run, and say when something shouldn't be built at all.

-
Turn business problems into build specs. Take a requirement at 30,000 feet — business logic, audience, desired end experience — and come back with something buildable, sequenced MVP first.

-
Think past the brief. Surface the requirement nobody asked for but everybody needed. The team defines what and why; you're expected to shape how, and to push back when the how reveals a problem with the what.

-
Roadmap everything you build. Every component is a product with real users, a feedback loop, and a next version. Nothing gets built once and abandoned.

-
Rally the stakeholders. An agent nobody adopts is a failed build. Getting there means data access, named content owners, permissions, and the right questions asked of the right people — often before anyone sees a line of code.

-
Partner with engineering. Work with BigBrain and BizApps where a build exceeds what one person should carry — and document and architect so that nothing critical depends on you alone.

-
A real example of the work: reps in one region aren't running AI discovery well. Telemetry confirms it's global, not local. The team scopes the gap and defines the solution -a new mode for our knowledge agent, "Disco Coach." You take that spec, decide how it actually gets built, ship the MVP, and own it from there.

Requirements

-
4+ years building software, automation, or AI solutions in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment. You don't need "engineer" in your title history — but this is not a junior role, and it is a genuinely technical one.

-
Mastery of AI building tools, especially agentic. Proven, hands-on experience shipping agents and AI systems that real people use daily — LLM and agent frameworks, Claude Code or equivalent, MCP, retrieval and RAG patterns, no-code and low-code platforms. Familiarity with monday's own AI products is an advantage.

-
Code-capable and comfortable in production. You write scripts, work with APIs and data, read logs, and debug things that break. You can maintain what you build without waiting for an engineering queue.

-
Product manager instincts. You can look at a problem from 30,000 feet, translate business logic and end-user experience into a specification, scope an MVP, and hold a roadmap. You've owned something end to end, not just executed tickets.

-
SaaS organizational fluency. You know how a software company works and who to go to. Experience in or alongside a sales organization is a strong advantage — client-facing, RevOps, sales systems, or solution engineering.

-
Experience with enablement, training, or knowledge systems is an advantage — LMS, knowledge bases, search, certification or simulation tooling. Not a requirement.

-
Stakeholder skill. You ask the right questions, understand who you're building for, and get the blocks in place so that what you ship actually gets adopted rather than admired.

-
Ownership over handoff. You document, you make things maintainable, and you don't build black boxes only you can operate.

-
Strong written and spoken communication — you can explain what you built, and what it can't do, to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

What monday.com can offer you:

-
Join a customer-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate - not just things we put on a wall

-
Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide

-
Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success

-
Grow fast through a dedicated L&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons - the industry moves quick and so do we

-
A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more

Full Time -Street Department Laborer

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The following duties are normal for this position.

These are not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive.

Other duties may be required and assigned.

Repairs, replaces, and maintains street signs and markers.

Performs manual labor in the repair and construction of streets; performs concrete work, chip seal, asphalt work, and patching on streets, sidewalks, curbs, trails, and parking lots.

Operates painting equipment to paint crosswalks, parking spaces, curbs, and other street and sidewalk markings.

Performs routine maintenance and repairs on equipment.

Mows weeds, cuts brush, trims trees, and cleans site by raking and/or hauling materials; clears storm drains of debris.

Clears snow from

City properties and sidewalks, snowplows streets, and hauls snow off site.

Operates trucks, tractors, mowers, posthole diggers, and other motorized equipment customarily used in the operation and maintenance of streets and facilities, and both motorized and non-motorized equipment.

Assists in general building and grounds cleaning and equipment maintenance work, maintains street shop.

Additional Tasks And Responsibilities

While the following tasks are necessary for the work of the unit, they are not an essential part of the purpose of this position and may also be performed by other unit members.

Helps install and remove snow fence and holiday decorations.

Attends safety meetings and seminars as required.

Assists other departments parks, cemetery, and wastewater as required.

Performs other duties as assigned or apparent.

Qualifications

Minimum Education or Experience Required: High school education or G.E.D., and six to twelve months related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Education or Experience Required: High school diploma or G.E.D., or twelve months to two years related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Other Requirements – Certificates/Licensures:

Valid Iowa Driver’s License and Commercial Driver’s license (CDL), with air brake endorsement issued by the State of Iowa (within allotted time after hire).

Meets City residency requirements.

About this role

לחברה מובילה דרוש/ה מפתח/ת Qlik Sense! מחפשים את האתגר הבא שלכם בעולם ה-BI והדאטה?

זו ההזדמנות להצטרף לתפקיד משמעותי המשלב פיתוח פתרונות BI, עבודה עם מודלי נתונים וניתוח צרכים עסקיים, בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת.

משרה מלאה והיברידית בתל אביב. 🔹 מה כולל התפקיד?  ניתוח צרכים עסקיים ותרגומם לאפיון ולפתרונות טכנולוגיים.  פיתוח ועיצוב דוחות ודשבורדים מקצה לקצה.  פיתוח מודלי נתונים ב-Qlik Sense, כולל עבודה עם DB, ERD ו-UI.  פיתוח מודלים מורכבים תוך דגש על ביצועים ואופטימיזציה.  עבודה מול מחסן נתונים (DWH) וממשקים ארגוניים מגוונים.  עבודה במתודולוגיית Agile. 🔹 דרישות התפקיד: ✅ לפחות שנתיים ניסיון בעבודה עם Qlik Sense  חובה. ✅ ניסיון בפיתוח ובבניית מודלי נתונים ב-Qlik Sense  חובה. ✅ תואר ראשון במדעי המחשב / הנדסה / כלכלה ומנהל עסקים  חובה. ✅ ניסיון בפיתוח מודלים מורכבים בדגש על Performance  חובה.

️ ניסיון בניהול הרשאות במודלים.
️ ניסיון בעבודה מול DWH.
️ היכרות עם MSSQL וכתיבת שאילתות ברמה גבוהה.
️ הבנה עסקית, יכולת עבודה מול ממשקים שונים, למידה עצמאית ותודעת שירות גבוהה.

About this role

הצטרפו לחטיבת מערכות טילים וחלל בחזית הטכנולוגיה, בתפקיד מרתק כמהנדס/ת פיתוח אלגוריתמי עיבוד אות ותקשורת.

אנו מחפשים כישרונות להוביל פיתוחים חדשניים שיעצבו את עתיד המערכות המורכבות שלנו.

התפקיד כולל פיתוח אלגוריתמים מתקדמים עבור מערכות מורכבות ופורצות דרך, משלבי בדיקת היתכנות ומחקר ועד ל-fixed point design ותמיכה מלאה בתהליכי מימוש ובדיקות מעבדה.

תעבדו בצוות פיתוח מנוסה, בעל ידע מקצועי עמוק ורחב, בסביבה טכנולוגית מאתגרת ומתקדמת.

תחומי האחריות:

פיתוח אלגוריתמים מתקדמים לעיבוד אות ותקשורת.

כתיבת מודלים וסימולציות מורכבות באמצעות
Matlab/Python
.

הובלת תהליכי פיתוח משלב האפיון הראשוני והמחקר.

מתן תמיכה טכנית למימוש אלגוריתמים בסביבות
FPGA/SW
.

זו הזדמנות ייחודית לצמוח מקצועית בסביבה דינמית, להשפיע באופן משמעותי על פרויקטים לאומיים ולקחת חלק בצוות מוביל וחדשני.

Requirements:

אנו מחפשים מועמד/ת בעל/ת יכולות טכניות גבוהות ומוטיבציה להצטרף לצוות הפיתוח שלנו.

הדרישות הבאות הינן חובה:

תואר שני בהנדסת חשמל
- הכרחי להבנת העקרונות התאורטיים והמעשיים הנדרשים לתפקיד.

ניסיון מקצועי של שנתיים לפחות
בפיתוח אלגוריתמי עיבוד אות ותקשורת, כולל הבנה מעמיקה של מתודולוגיות פיתוח.

מוטיבציה גבוהה
ללמידה מתמדת וליזום פתרונות יצירתיים, יחד עם יחסי אנוש מעולים לעבודה שיתופית בצוות.
